get_training_parser: build a fairseq training argument parser with dataset, distributed, optimization, and checkpointing args
get_generation_parser: build a fairseq generation argument parser with beam search, sampling, and length penalty options
get_preprocessing_parser: build a fairseq preprocessing argument parser for binning source and target language data
parse_args_and_arch: parse command line args and dynamically add model-specific arguments from the architecture registry
get_eval_lm_parser: build a fairseq language model evaluation argument parser with word probability and context window options
